summary: Clearwater NF lookout: 15-ft tree platform 1917, 25-ft platform 1919, L-4 cab 1941, abandoned 1963; gone; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 15-foot tree platform (1917), 25-foot tree platform (1919), L-4 cab by 1941
facts.status_note: Abandoned 1963 and gone; no source gives a removal date or describes remains

events.note: 15-foot tree platform; Ron Kemnow credits Paul Wohlen, citing The Clearwater Story

evidence.supports: 1917 and 1919 platforms, 1941 L-4 cab, abandoned 1963, gone
evidence.quote: 1917: 15' tree platform. 1919: 25' tree platform. 1941: L-4 cab. Abandoned 1963. Gone.

evidence.supports: 1917 built by Paul Wohlen (citing The Clearwater Story)

evidence.quote: Built by Paul Wohlen. (The Clearwater Story, Clearwater National Forest)

elevation 6,534 ft (Forest Service list row for Cook Mtn)
site labelled Hike-In; describes how it is reached, not whether it is open

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: U.S. Forest Service (list compiled by Margaret Sand, Walde Lookout and Cindy Schacher, June 2016)

corrections.why: The Forest Service list gives the 1917 structure as a 15' tree platform and the 1919 one as a 25' tree platform; Rex Kamstra and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe the same. The ground label matches the FFLA list (source 5) but not the other four sources. The 1941 L-4 cab is not described as ground-level, so the editor should choose between tree and tower.

notes_for_editor: History is consistent across four sources: platform 1917, 25 ft 1919, L-4 cab 1941, abandoned 1963. No source describes what remains at the site or whether it is public, so access and remains are not set. Kind correction is a proposal for the editor to confirm (tree vs tower). Elevation 6,534 ft is in the story, not a facts key. No new photos found.
